baseline.purpose: Frozen 3.15 reflection pass used to reproduce sampler/output texture object alias at the renderer boundary; no simulated GPU and no image acceptance.

sharedSampler.scope: Shader composition only; actual active-uniform evidence comes from the separate native WebGL capture.

before.scope: Exact JS object identity at renderer.render; this is not a substitute for the independently captured GL1282.

exactRestoration.scope: State preservation contract; ordinary configuration uses the capture target texture.

verificationType: Production material and reflection module on a CPU renderer boundary observer; no WebGL context, getError emulation or pixel acceptance.

specification.section: Feedback Loops Between Textures and the Framebuffer

remainingAcceptance: Same-condition native WebGL after-capture and 14-frame per-draw audit with zero new GL errors, using the final rebuilt identity. Existing 3.15 failure remains recorded.
